script_parts.opening: Namaskar, RNG Vivo Private Limited se baat ho rahi hai? Ji, main IndiaMART se call kar raha hoon — dekh raha hoon ki aapka account kaafi purana hai, almost 25 saal se aap hamare saath hain, lekin pichle 30 dinon mein ek bhi login nahi hua aur zero enquiries aayi hain — yeh dekh ke thoda concern hua, isliye directly call kiya.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai ji, seedha poochhna chahta hoon — kuch mahine pehle aapka account active tha, phir achanak activity bilkul band ho gayi, toh kya koi specific issue tha platform ke saath, ya business mein koi change aaya jiske wajah se aapne IndiaMART use karna band kar diya?
script_parts.value_demo: Ek important baat share karna chahta hoon — aapka CQS score 83 hai, jo actually bahut strong hai, matlab aapka catalog aur profile buyers ke liye ready hai. Lekin demand tier abhi Red zone mein hai, yaani market mein competition tight hai aur agar account dormant raha toh jo bhi organic visibility thi, woh bhi slip ho rahi hai — yeh window close hone se pehle recover karna zaroori hai.
script_parts.action: Toh bhai ji, abhi is call pe hi ek kaam karte hain — main aapka account open karta hoon aur aapke saath milke ek product listing review karte hain, dekhte hain ki koi setting ya lead preference toh galat nahi set hai jo enquiries rok rahi ho — sirf 5 minute lagenge.
script_parts.close: Aaj ke liye bas itna kaafi hai — agar aap kal ya parson ek baar apna IndiaMART dashboard khol ke mujhe ek missed call dein, main aapko callback karoonga aur hum milke next step decide karenge, koi pressure nahi, bas ek baar reconnect karte hain platform se.

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, am I speaking with someone from RNG Vivo Private Limited? This is a call from IndiaMART — I can see your account is nearly 25 years old with us, but in the last 30 days there have been zero logins and zero enquiries, which flagged as a concern on our end, so I wanted to reach out directly.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: I want to ask you directly — your account was active a couple of months ago and then activity dropped completely, so was there a specific issue with the platform, or did something change in your business that led you to step away from IndiaMART?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's something worth noting — your CQS score is 83, which is actually quite strong, meaning your catalog and profile are well set up for buyers. However, the demand tier for your category is currently in the Red zone, meaning competition is tight, and with a dormant account your organic visibility is slipping further — this is a critical window to recover before it worsens.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one concrete thing right now on this call — I'll pull up your account and we'll review one product listing together to check if any lead preference or setting is misconfigured that might be blocking enquiries — it'll take just 5 minutes.
script_parts_en.close: That's all for today — if you can open your IndiaMART dashboard once tomorrow or the day after and give me a missed call, I'll call you back and we can decide the next step together, no pressure, just one small reconnect with the platform.

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
